name: plugin-migrator
summary: Migrate QwenPaw 1.x plugins to QwenPaw 2.0 and scaffold QwenPaw 2.0 plugins. Use when porting plugins, fixing plugin.json compatibility constraints (qwenpaw_version / min_version), debugging plugins disabled or inert in 2.0, fixing register_prompt_section errors, auditing agent/runtime internal API usage, or using 2.0 PluginApi methods such as register_middleware, register_slash_command, register_mode, register_runtime_hook, and register_agent_stop_handler.
